summary: Nameless Cat 1.2.7 on muOS (RG40XX-H): install/video OK, GPTK owner loaded (9 sinks, contexts menu then gameplay), D-pad and left stick move, no other button answers, SELECT+START dead (device had to be rebooted). Receipt: NXC6-DOMAIN ... rewritten=1 rewritten_bindings=15 ... volume_markers=2 result=rewritten; NXC6-SEAM ... source=env-get-controls ... matching=2 ... source_domain=joydev-legacy target_domain=sdl2-evdev; controller: Deeplay-keys ... a:b0,b:b1,x:b3,y:b2,...back:b6,start:b7 (POST-rewrite output, never an input fixture).

device.ev_key_note: Field reported 17 buttons; the DTS-proved set is 0x72/0x73/0x130..0x13c (15) plus one low key before 0x72 (muOS binds volumedown=b1). The 17th code is unknown and NOT fabricated; it cannot change ordinals b0..b15 unless it precedes 0x13c, which the muOS line (a=b3, rightstick=b15) excludes.

source.provenance: two byte-identical official muOS lines for the GUID (Deeplay-keys and muOS-Keys names) as pinned in framework-v4 ports/fp2/controllers-retro.nxb lines 13-14; the POST-rewrite readback a:b0,b:b1,x:b3,y:b2 is only consistent with the RETRO variant (a:b3,b:b4,x:b6,y:b5) as input
source.domain_claimed: sdl2-ascending-patched (muOS SDL2 with the RetroArch patch set) -- UNPROVEN until the muOS DSO is pinned

observed: dpad+left-stick movement; expected face actions absent; chord absent

v4_behaviour.asymmetry_explained: hats and axes keep their numbering in both domains on this pad (no ABS code >= ABS_MISC); only button ordinals shift by the three low keys, so movement survives while faces/back/start land on other physical keys
